Initial release of AI Video Editor Happy Birthday — create polished birthday videos from your photos and clips.

- Instantly turns user photos/clips into a share-ready birthday celebration video with music, transitions, and message overlay.
- No manual editing required; simple upload and prompt.
- Supports major file types (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 500MB).
- Fully cloud-based editing and export pipeline; delivers 1080p MP4 downloads in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes 100 free credits for easy first-time use.
